scope: Remove the docs page intro and replace the hero's clipped pointer glow with a site-wide cursor glow. No engine, release, legal, physical-device or GA qualification.

tools.browser: Claude desktop in-app browser; Google Chrome 155.0.8059.82 headless

changes: Docs page: removed the eyebrow, title and lede intro; kept a visually hidden h1 so the page still has a top-level heading.
Removed the hero's bounded pointer glow, whose box edges showed as hard lines.

Added one fixed cursor glow behind content on every page, created on first fine-pointer movement, moved by transform through one animation frame per burst of events, and hidden when the pointer leaves the window, on reduced motion, or without a fine pointer.
Workflow band background made translucent so the glow shows through it with the same apparent color.
automated_scope: Four new motion tests: frame coalescing and element reuse, window exit, reduced-motion/coarse/touch exclusion, and preference changes hiding the glow. Hero spotlight assertions removed with the feature.
limitations: No public domain or production deployment; preview remains noindex.
Pointer checks used a desktop mouse; physical phones remain disconnected.
No GA gate or accountable reviewer acceptance changed.
